title: solo_handback never captures the prove_red baseline; sprint-complete then fails with no honest recovery
detail: push-carries-suite-pass: triage fell through to solo, drive escalated solo_handback at triage. drive captures RED only in _building (drive.py ~409), which the solo path never runs, and neither the solo_handback reason, sprint-run step 5a, nor the solo_execute->reviewing advance mentions or requires prove-red. The gap surfaced only at gate sprint-complete in integrating ('no captured RED baseline'), after the change was already integrated, so the baseline had to be captured by temporarily restoring the old scripts/pre-push.sh. Fix: capture prove-red at the solo hand-off (before the build) or block solo_execute->reviewing without it, keyed to the ledger's criterion_red_baseline events.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_solo_red_baseline.py
